content: 다항식 $p(x)=x^3-ax^2-11x-21$이 최고차항 계수가 $1$인 두 다항식 $f(x), g(x)$의 곱으로 인수분해 되고 $f(7)=0$일 때, $f(1)+g(1)$의 값은? [4.3점]
sourceMathEvidence: Current stem: p(x)=x³−ax²−11x−21 is factored into two monic polynomials f,g and f(7)=0; the requested value is f(1)+g(1). Under the standard nontrivial real-polynomial factorization convention, both factors have positive degree.
solutionMathEvidence: p(7)=343−49a−77−21=245−49a=0 gives a=5. Dividing p=x³−5x²−11x−21 by x−7 gives x²+2x+3 with discriminant −8, so the remaining quadratic has no real linear factor. Since f contains x−7, the only nonconstant real factor allocation is f=x−7, g=x²+2x+3. Their values at 1 are −6 and 6, sum 0, matching choice ②.
